app.title: ECAD Forge
app.subtitle: Client-side schematic, PCB, 3D and BOM views for native Altium documents and KiCad files or projects.
app.dropTitle: Parse native Altium and KiCad files entirely in the browser
app.dropCopy: The parser extracts printable native records from Altium documents and KiCad files or projects, normalizes them, and feeds schematic, PCB, BOM, diagnostics, and interactive 3D views while attempting to resolve companion WRL and STEP models from the current session.
